answer: Vouching with decaying bonds: each new identity only earns after two established peers stake standing on it, and each voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N real reputations, and every caught fake leaves a trail of evidence the network replays. The comet of a bad vouch is public, the falcon of each slash deters the next attempt, and the violet trail of every vouch stays replayable, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
